name: Word of the Day

daily.prompt: Pick an interesting, real English word that most adults rarely use. Give its part of speech, a one-sentence definition in plain words, and one example sentence.

words.definition: The pleasant, earthy smell after rain falls on dry ground.
words.example: The petrichor drifted in through the open window.
